data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'grace', Graniah means 'graceful, shining light'. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the light of God shining upon an individual. The name Graniah carries the meaning “Graceful, shining light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Graniah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
